topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per Rule 520-2-.02(4)(c), how much audio or video material may a school use toward meeting required in-class instruction hours without prior written Commission authorization?
choice_b: Audio/video material is never permitted toward in-class hours
choice_d: No more than 30 minutes
explanation: Schools shall utilize no more than thirty minutes of audio or video material toward meeting required or make-up in-class instruction hours unless the Commission grants prior written authorization.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Under Rule 520-2-.02(2)(b), how long must an approved school's records management plan retain student attendance and exam score records?
choice_b: At least three years
choice_d: At least ten years
explanation: The school's application must include a detailed proposal for retaining student attendance records, graded exercise/exam scores, and student certifications for at least five years.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per the PSI Candidate Information Bulletin, a school's final examination for the Salespersons Prelicense Course and Brokers Prelicense Course must consist of no fewer than how many questions to avoid needing Commission pre-approval of the exam?
choice_b: One hundred questions
choice_d: One hundred fifty questions
explanation: A school need not submit a course final exam to the Commission for approval if it is multiple choice with at least four choices, and the Salespersons/Brokers Prelicense final exam has no fewer than one hundred questions (fifty for CAM/Sales Postlicense).
source_note: PSI Candidate Information Bulletin, Examination Formats

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per the same source, the final examination for the Community Association Managers Prelicense Course and the Sales Postlicense Course must consist of no fewer than how many questions?
choice_b: Seventy-five questions
choice_d: One hundred questions
explanation: The final examination for the Community Association Managers Prelicense Course and the Sales Postlicense Course must consist of no fewer than fifty questions to avoid requiring Commission pre-approval.
source_note: PSI Candidate Information Bulletin, Examination Formats

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Under the Commission's course-final-exam passing score rule, what standard must a school require students to achieve on final exams for prelicense/postlicense courses?
choice_b: There is no passing score requirement for school final exams
choice_c: Whatever score the individual instructor personally prefers
choice_d: A passing score consistent with the passing score required on the state qualifying examination for that license, absent written Commission permission for a different score
explanation: Schools must require students to achieve a passing score on course final examinations consistent with the passing score required on state qualifying examinations for that license, unless the school has first obtained written Commission permission to require a different passing score.
source_note: Real estate course rules, Passing Score requirement

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per the Rules, how many minimum instructional hours must a Community Association Managers Prelicense Course provide?
choice_b: 40 hours
choice_d: 75 hours
explanation: A Community Association Managers Prelicense Course must provide for a minimum of twenty-five instructional hours.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per the Rules, a computer-based course for the Salespersons Prelicense course must reasonably require the student to expend at least how many hours completing the required content areas?
choice_b: 75 hours
choice_d: 100 hours
explanation: A computer-based Salespersons Prelicense course must reasonably require at least seventy-five hours to complete, matching the in-class course requirement; the Brokers Prelicense computer-based course requires sixty hours.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Under Rule 520-2-.02, no school coordinator or director shall allow anyone to recruit new affiliates on the school's premises during what window relative to an instruction period?
choice_b: At any time on the school's premises, with no time restriction
choice_c: One hour before, one hour after, or during an instruction period
choice_d: Recruiting is permitted as long as it occurs off school premises
explanation: No school coordinator/director shall allow anyone to use school premises or a classroom to recruit new affiliates for any company one hour before, one hour after, or during an instruction period.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per Rule 520-2-.02(9)(d), when an approved school advertises its exam passing percentage, which of the following is a required element of that advertisement?
choice_a: A vague claim such as 'more than 80% passing' is acceptable
choice_b: Only the total number of graduates needs to be disclosed
choice_c: No specific data is required as long as the school believes the claim is true
choice_d: The passing rate must be expressed as a specific percentage, based only on first-time examinees, for the prior calendar year, and stated separately for salesperson vs. broker exams
explanation: Passing percentage advertising must state a specific percentage (not vague language), based on first-time examinees only, for the prior calendar year, and salesperson/broker rates may not be combined; the actual numbers tested and passing must also be included.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per Rule 520-2-.02(9)(a), if a school wishes to use the name 'Georgia Real Estate Commission' in its advertising, what type-size restriction applies?
choice_a: The phrase 'Georgia Real Estate Commission' may not appear anywhere in the advertisement in larger type than the words preceding or following it
choice_b: The phrase may appear in any size, including larger than surrounding text
choice_c: The phrase must always be the largest text in the advertisement
choice_d: Use of the Commission's name in advertising is banned entirely
explanation: The phrase 'Georgia Real Estate Commission' can never appear anywhere in an advertisement in larger type than the words and phrases preceding or following it, and the ad must clarify the Commission's role is limited to compliance oversight.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Under Rule 520-1-.06(2), which of the following must every written property management agreement specify, per the Rules?
choice_a: The exact date the owner purchased the property
choice_b: Whether security deposits and prepaid rents will be held by the broker or the owner
choice_d: The property's most recent appraised value
explanation: Every written property management agreement must specify, among other things, whether security deposits and prepaid rents will be held by the broker or the owner.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per O.C.G.A. 43-40-1, a 'community association management services' provider performs which of the following functions for a community association, for valuable consideration?
choice_b: Only legal representation in association disputes
choice_c: Collecting, controlling, or disbursing funds; obtaining insurance; coordinating maintenance; and overseeing day-to-day operations of the association
choice_d: Only tax preparation for the association
explanation: 'Community association management services' means providing, for valuable consideration, management or administrative services including collecting/controlling/disbursing funds, obtaining insurance, coordinating maintenance, and overseeing day-to-day operations of the association.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Under Rule 520-1-.06(3)(a)5, if a fidelity bond or insurance policy required for community association management is to be cancelled or substantially modified for non-payment of premiums, how much prior written notice must be given?
choice_b: No notice is required for non-payment cancellations
choice_d: No less than 10 days
explanation: The insurer may not cancel, substantially modify, or refuse to renew the bond/policy without giving thirty days' prior written notice, except in the case of non-payment of premiums, where no less than ten days' notice is required.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per Rule 520-1-.08(4), trust accounts maintained for property or association management: what must be true of the account balance relative to security deposits kept in a designated rental trust account?
choice_a: The account balance must always equal at least the total of all security deposits credited to tenants
choice_b: There is no minimum balance requirement for security deposits
choice_c: Security deposits may be commingled freely with the broker's operating funds
choice_d: Security deposits must be converted to a certificate of deposit within 30 days
explanation: Security deposits kept in a designated rental trust or escrow account must be clearly identified and credited to the tenant, with the account balance always equal to at least the total of those security deposits.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Under Rule 520-1-.08(4)(c), a licensee who manages rental property that the licensee personally owns must handle collected security deposits how?
choice_a: May post a surety bond instead of maintaining a trust account
choice_b: Must maintain the security deposits in a designated trust account and may not substitute a bond
choice_c: May deposit them into the licensee's personal checking account
choice_d: Is exempt from all trust account requirements as the property owner
explanation: A licensee managing rental property they own must maintain collected security deposits in a designated trust account and may not post a bond in lieu of doing so.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per Rule 520-2-.02(8), how long must approved schools maintain copies of examinations given and their answer keys?
choice_b: Three years
choice_d: Ten years
explanation: All approved schools must maintain, for at least five years, copies of all examinations given and the answer keys for those examinations, along with texts, materials, and attendance/score records.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Under Rule 520-1-.08(5), how often does the Commission's examination cycle require a broker's designated trust account to be examined?
choice_b: Only if a formal complaint is filed
choice_c: Every ten years regardless of renewal cycle
choice_d: During each renewal period, or at such other time as the Commission directs upon reasonable cause
explanation: O.C.G.A. 43-40-20 requires each broker maintaining a designated trust account to authorize its examination by the Commission during each renewal period, or at another time the Commission directs upon reasonable cause.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per Rule 520-1-.08(5)(b), a broker being examined may elect to provide the Commission with what alternative to a Commission-conducted trust account examination?
choice_a: A report from a Certified Public Accountant, which the Commission may accept in lieu of its own examination
choice_b: A self-certification with no third-party verification
choice_c: A notarized personal statement from the broker alone
choice_d: There is no alternative; the Commission's examination is always mandatory
explanation: A broker may elect to provide a report on the trust account(s) from a Certified Public Accountant in lieu of an examination by the Commission, though the Commission may decline the report and examine the account itself.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Under Rule 520-2-.02(6)(a), if an approved school terminates its relationship with an instructor because of the instructor's rule violation, what must the school do?
choice_a: Nothing; instructor terminations are private personnel matters
choice_b: Notify the Commission immediately
choice_c: Wait until the next renewal period to report it
choice_d: Only report it if the instructor requests a hearing
explanation: The school must notify the Commission immediately if it terminates its relationship with an instructor because of the instructor's violation of any provision of the education standards chapter.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per Rule 520-1-.07(6)(e), which of the following is a task the Commission has identified that support personnel MAY perform?
choice_a: Explain a lease agreement to a prospective tenant
choice_b: Discuss the terms and conditions of a listing with the owner
choice_d: Provide advice on whether to accept a purchase offer
explanation: Support personnel may compute commission checks -- a ministerial task -- but may not discuss listing terms, explain contracts, or give advice on offers, all of which require a license.

topic: Real Estate Education, Course Standards & Community Association Management
question: Per Rule 520-1-.02(2)(o), what is the minimum duration that qualifies as one 'instructional hour' under the Commission's education rules?
choice_b: At least 55 minutes
choice_d: At least 50 minutes
explanation: 'Instructional hour' means a period of time of at least fifty minutes of instruction or other learning activity.
